known_bias: Cities are chosen by where this community travels, which means the list tracks conference and camp locations in wealthy countries. The places where a low-protein diet is hardest to eat are not on it. That is a real limitation of coverage and not a reason to reorder the list -- a guide that serves the trips families actually take beats a globally balanced one nobody uses.
superseded: v0.1 reordered these cities by disclosure regime and recommended running Brisbane early because it lacks an award program. That inverted the geography for the agent's methodological convenience. The city list reflects travel priorities; the method adapts to the city, not the reverse. Every city starts the same way Asheville did: award layer first if one exists, then local lists, then community.

event_anchors.implication: This is the nearest hard date in the project and it changes Copenhagen from a research city into a deadline. Two months is not enough to build a Danish lexicon, capture 21 restaurants, and verify accommodation. Scope to what a delegate can use in October: restaurants walkable from the venue and hotels, menus captured however possible including by hand, and the request card translated into Danish.
